zh: 请两人一组做这个练习。
en: Please {pair up|team up|get into pairs} for this exercise.

zh: 老师当着全班的面点名批评了汤姆。
en: The teacher {singled out|picked on|called out} Tom in front of the whole class.

zh: 她大二的时候从大学退学了。
en: She {dropped out of|left|quit} uni in her second year.

zh: 她考上了奥克兰大学。
en: She {got into|was accepted into|got accepted into} Auckland Uni.

zh: 最后一道题难倒了很多学生。
en: The last question {caught out|tripped up|tricked|fooled|confused} a lot of students.

zh: 学英语很难，但要坚持下去。
en: Learning English is hard, but {keep at|stick at|stick with} it.

zh: 我因为拼写错误被扣了分。
en: I got {marked down} for bad spelling.

zh: 去法国之前我得复习一下法语。
en: I need to {brush up on|polish up|practise|practice|work on|revise} my French before the trip.

zh: 老师一个一个地念出名字。
en: The teacher {called out|read out|read} the names one by one.

zh: 老师把试卷发了下去。
en: The teacher {passed out|handed out|gave out|distributed} the exam papers.

zh: 她的努力终于有了回报。
en: All her hard work finally {paid off}.

zh: 上课别瞎胡闹了！
en: Stop {messing around|mucking around|mucking about|messing about|fooling around} in class!

zh: 她想从事护理工作。
en: She wants to {go into|get into} nursing.

zh: 你考试考得怎么样？
en: How did you {get on|go|do} in your exam?

zh: 我的数学考试勉强及格了。
en: I just {scraped through|squeaked through|passed} my maths exam.

zh: 考试快到了，你得开始用功了。
en: Exams are coming up, so you'd better {knuckle down|buckle down|get stuck in|focus}.

zh: 他上课讲话，老师让他放学后留下来。
en: He talked in class, so the teacher made him {stay behind|stay back} after school.

zh: 面试前我得先了解一下这家公司。
en: I need to {read up on|research|look into|find out about} the company before my interview.

zh: 一定要在周五之前交作业。
en: Make sure you {hand in|submit|turn in} your assignment by Friday.

zh: 我跟同事学会了几句毛利语。
en: I've {picked up|learnt|learned} a few words of te reo from my workmates.

zh: 别聊天了，赶紧做你的功课。
en: Stop chatting and {get on with|carry on with|continue} your work.

zh: 她轻轻松松就通过了驾照笔试。
en: She {breezed through|sailed through|flew through|aced} her driving theory test.

zh: 老师把我们的作文发回来了。
en: The teacher {handed back|gave back|returned} our essays.

zh: 高年级的孩子们联合起来欺负他。
en: The older kids {ganged up on|picked on|bullied} him.

zh: 我从图书馆借了三本书。
en: I {checked out|borrowed|took out|got out} three books from the library.

zh: 把错的答案划掉，再写上正确的。
en: {Cross out|Strike out|Scratch out} the wrong answer and write the correct one.

zh: 孩子们什么时候放暑假？
en: When do the kids {break up|finish} for the summer holidays?

zh: 不认识的词就上网查一下意思。
en: If you don't know a word, just {look up|check|google} its meaning online.

zh: 上课时我走神了。
en: I {zoned out|switched off|drifted off|spaced out} during the lecture.

zh: 我每周五下午留出一小时学英语。
en: I {set aside|put aside|block out|keep} an hour every Friday afternoon for English.

zh: 她每次考试前都特别紧张。
en: She gets really {wound up|worked up|stressed out|stressed} before exams.

zh: 快点写，时间快到了！
en: Hurry up, time is {running out}!

zh: 我在外面等着，等你下课。
en: I'll {hang around|wait around|stick around|wait} outside until your class finishes.

zh: 考试前一晚别熬夜。
en: Don't {stay up|sit up} late the night before the exam.

zh: 别再瞎闹了，快去写作业。
en: Stop {fooling around|mucking around|messing around|messing about|mucking about|playing around} and do your homework.

zh: 老师让全班安静下来。
en: The teacher asked the class to {quieten down|quiet down|settle down|calm down|be quiet}.

zh: 最后一道题把大部分学生都难住了。
en: The last question {tripped up|caught out|confused|tricked} most students.

zh: 她说的你都记下来了吗？
en: Did you {get down|write down|note down|take down} everything she said?

zh: 时间到，请放下笔。
en: Time's up. Please {lay down|put down} your pens.

zh: 把生词写在本子上。
en: {Write down|Note down|Jot down} the new words in your notebook.

zh: 你交作业了吗？
en: Have you {turned in|handed in|submitted} your assignment?
